title: Security re-review of Sprint 5 fixes; close findings with real tests
story: As the sponsor I want an independent security re-review to decide which findings are closed so that the open-finding tally is true
acceptance: For each of SEC2-009, 010, 011, 013, 014, 017, SEC3-002..006 and the policy-vehicles oracle: re-verify against the code at HEAD by reading and running it, then record fixed / partly fixed / open with evidence in a new section 13 'Sprint 5 re-review (S5-SEC-01)' of architecture/security-review-s2.md; only a finding verified fixed by a passing real test is closed

Flip t.todo to a real test for every finding verified fixed (SEC2-009, 010, 013, 017 at least if verified); add tests/security/s5-regressions.test.mjs covering the oracle (uniform 404 claimant/agent, last name + ZIP, per-policy lockout across sessions and parallel requests from S5-WFL-05), unsafe tenant regex rejected at save (SEC2-014/SEC3-003), labelled-name redaction before cloud calls (S5-AI-08), X-Fnol-Authorization accepted and bad tokens rejected in either header (S5-EXP-01)
Security gate for S5-WFL-05 (src/modules/intake/service.js lockout, intake/index.mjs migration): report findings in section 13; a high finding is a blocker posted to the security hub
Refresh routes.snapshot.json only if the role matrix changed this sprint, and say which operation changed

Section 13 ends with a true tally of open findings by severity (do not count a finding closed because its ticket was accepted); also list known accepted risks: R2 devMode on the IAP-only deployment (deferred to Sprint 6 by decision), KMS spike envelope not tenant-bound (spike, not wired)
npm test passes with 0 failures and fewer todos than the baseline in org/quality-baseline.txt
brief: Sprint 5 tickets and their files: org/board/tickets/S5-*.json and git log. The fixes landed on main; read the security hub and decisions hub first. You are the only writer of tests/security this sprint. If a fix is incomplete, leave its todo, mark it open with the exact failing scenario, and post a blocker to the security hub; do not fix product code.

verdicts.reason: All criteria met: section 13 with verdicts/tally/accepted risks, todos 7->3, regressions test added, e2e+security 400 pass 0 fail; only caveat is a pre-existing flaky tests/ui/csr test outside scope
